title: No truth in advertising
text: No truth in advertising. They claim these are dishwasher safe however they rot when you put them in a dishwasher. I have had 2 pairs now rot away so I have to hand wash the rest. Just not worth it. I bought these so I wouldn't have to keep hand washing my chopsticks!
